description: This Java class 'JobDetailDataValidator' performs validation on JSON data related to job details, specifically for updates. It checks for supported parameters, ensures parameters are not blank, and validates specific values like cron expressions and boolean statuses. It throws validation exceptions if errors are encountered.

classes.name: JobDetailDataValidator
classes.description: A component class responsible for validating JSON data related to job details update requests within the system.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the provided JSON string for updating job details. Checks for supported parameters, required fields, and proper formats. Throws exceptions if validation fails.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if any validation errors have been collected during the validation process.
